h1: Aurora Suvarnabhumi Hotel Samut Prakan — a budget stay with a hot spring bath in Bang Bo
intro: If you want a stay near Suvarnabhumi Airport that's easy on the wallet yet packs in more than you'd expect, Aurora Suvarnabhumi Hotel is worth a look. This 264-room hotel sits in Bang Bo, just off Bangna-Trad Road. Its talking point is a public hot spring bath and steam room — rare at this price near the airport — plus an outdoor pool, a kids' pool, a playground and free parking. It opened in 2019 and was renovated in 2022. Rates start at around ฿650/night and it scores 8.4 from real guest reviews on Trip.com. Just keep in mind it's a longer drive to the airport than the hotels that sit right next to it.

body.html: What sets Aurora Suvarnabhumi apart from the usual airport-area hotel is its public hot spring bath and steam room. Among the budget-to-low-midrange stays in this area, few give you somewhere to soak and unwind like this. There's also an outdoor pool, a children's pool, a playground, a fitness centre and a garden — this is a hotel built for an actual stay with the family, not just a one-night layover before a flight.

Rooms run from Superior Double and Superior Twin (around 30 sqm) to Superior Suite (35 sqm) and Deluxe Suite (40 sqm). Real reviews consistently praise how clean and quiet the rooms are, since many face the inner courtyard. Each comes with a desk, coffee machine, fridge, minibar, safe and flat-screen TV, and many have a private balcony or terrace. The building was refreshed in 2022, so it still feels new.
"Spotless rooms, very quiet because they face inward, helpful staff, and great value for what you get — there's even a hot spring bath to soak in. The kids loved the children's pool."

The hotel sits in Bang Bo just off Bangna-Trad Road, close to Assumption University (ABAC) Bangna campus. That makes it handy for parents dropping off or visiting students, or for anyone with business around the southern stretch of Bangna-Trad. There are restaurants and shops scattered along the main road, but this is very much a drive-everywhere area, not a walkable neighbourhood.

The one thing to plan around most is the distance to Suvarnabhumi Airport — roughly 24 km, about 29 minutes by car. That's noticeably farther than the hotels right by the airport in the Kingkaew or Racha Thewa area. There is a paid airport shuttle, but for an early-morning flight you'll want to check timings and book the car ahead. Aurora suits travellers after a good-value, relaxing base far more than those who need a bed right next to the terminal.

A couple of other points reviewers raise: some staff aren't fully fluent in English at certain times, and getting into central Bangkok or the main sightseeing areas is a fair trek. If you plan to head into the city or out to Pak Nam often, budget the time and transport. But for anyone whose plans already centre on Bang Bo and southern Bangna, none of this is an issue.

Overall, Aurora Suvarnabhumi scores 8.4 out of 10 on Trip.com from real guest reviews. It's strong value among Bang Bo's hotels — clean, quiet rooms, a hot spring bath, pool, kids' pool and free parking, all from a low starting rate. Prices begin around ฿650 and climb with season and room type into the low thousands for the suites. If you can live with the longer airport drive and the drive-everywhere location, it's an appealing low-cost base in Samut Prakan.

tips.body: Reviews say the inward-facing rooms are quieter — if you're a light sleeper, request a courtyard side at check-in.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Aurora Suvarnabhumi Hotel

faq.q: How far is Aurora Suvarnabhumi from Suvarnabhumi Airport, and is there a shuttle?
faq.a: The hotel is in Bang Bo, just off Bangna-Trad Road, about 24 km — roughly 29 minutes by car — from Suvarnabhumi Airport. There's a paid airport shuttle; share your flight time and book ahead. It's better suited to a relaxed stay than to a crash before a very early flight.

faq.q: Does Aurora Suvarnabhumi really have a hot spring?
faq.a: Yes. The hotel has a public hot spring bath and steam room to soak and unwind — something you rarely find at this price near the airport. Pack swimwear if you'd like to use it.

faq.q: What are the room rates and room types at Aurora Suvarnabhumi?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿650/night for a Superior Double. Options run from Superior Twin (~30 sqm) and Superior Suite (~35 sqm) to Deluxe Suite (~40 sqm). Prices rise with season and room type into the low thousands — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Aurora Suvarnabhumi best for?
faq.a: It suits families after a budget-friendly stay, parents visiting ABAC Bangna students, and anyone with business around southern Bangna-Trad. It has a hot spring, pool, kids' pool and free parking. Because it's a fair distance from both the airport and the city, it's less ideal if you need to be closest to the terminal.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Aurora Suvarnabhumi clean and quiet?
faq.a: Most real reviews praise the rooms as clean and quiet, especially those facing the inner courtyard. The building was renovated in 2022 so it still feels new, and rooms come with a coffee machine, fridge, minibar and often a balcony or terrace.

faq.q: Does Aurora Suvarnabhumi have parking and a pool?
faq.a: Yes to both. It has free parking, an outdoor swimming pool, a children's pool and a playground — ideal if you're driving and travelling with kids.
